verdict.rationale: Opting out of telemetry and usage tracking is a fair privacy-posture question for a SaaS scheduling product, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence pack documents a telemetry or usage-tracking opt-out control. The pack covers scheduling, the API, MCP, webhooks, and authentication, but none of these address telemetry.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can opt out of telemetry and usage tracking
